name: petty-sermon
label: Petty victory sermon (dreamy hype-preacher comedy)
description: From ref 'Who is that man in my family that said I'll fail?' (@jerrydeberry2333, 50K likes, 35 s, ONE take, 0 cuts, 125 wpm). A deadpan-proud character in a victory setting (graduation gown, gym, clinic opening) delivers an over-the-top preacher cadence rant at the doubters; heavy dreamy haze/glow grade; ONE big word at a time, white caps with a cyan outline, centred; epic/choir bed. The joke is the mismatch: tiny win, biblical delivery.
